study.question: Does the auxiliary-supervision click benefit require context learning through the residual adapter, the context-history product adapter, or their combination, at fixed forward architecture and four true-label objectives?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: DIN click AUC is 0.6555440824200336. The strongest imported joint model and its exact same-seed replay reach 0.668457307890924; click-only and fully context-blocked true auxiliary training both reach 0.6678548720585206 (joint gain 0.0006024358324033807). The batch-rolled auxiliary replacement reaches 0.6674639465810746. Individual cart/fav/buy context routes reach 0.6674277598220023/0.6677933678779057/0.6673203922314733; cart+fav/cart+buy/fav+buy reach 0.6681492092675291/0.6677197868887434/0.6677967453158369. Increasing fav+buy context scale to1.5 gives 0.6676677777758943; joint scale2/3 gives 0.6681406600260333. None improves on joint. Thus task count or a simple sum of independent task benefits does not explain this one-seed trajectory; no gradient geometry was measured. The still-unresolved architecture detail is that the existing adapter context gate simultaneously controls residual_bank and context_queries. Provisional mechanism: product-conditioned auxiliary learning may supply more useful context updates than the residual-only path, with possible complementarity. This predicts a larger product-only benefit over fully blocked than residual-only, and a possible positive both-path interaction. This is a falsifiable path-localization hypothesis, not a novelty or conflict-projection claim.

nearest_work.difference: Closest empirical control is the unchanged imported joint architecture in history_g0_r0039_context_product.py, source SHA256 a2fe811c7ef287b2028ec5b5844ce47c40847af521e6d4e7dffd63834e2ed380. Previously both adapter context edges were gated together; independently detach them after branching without removing either forward adapter.

Prior changes chose task subsets and scaled a single context edge before both adapters. Here all auxiliary tasks transfer at unit strength through each enabled path; only adapter destination varies. Inherit exactly its joint FP32 training_loss hook, without task-subset or gradient-scaling machinery.

study.proposed_difference: Add two boolean training-only stop-gradient gates immediately after the shared adapter context branches into residual_bank and context_queries. Execute a complete R/P 2x2 factorial with two candidate single-path variants and open/blocked control bridges. All four tasks, private modules, true labels and forward values remain. No custom surrogate gradients, no loss weighting, no new trainable parameters and no information-boundary changes. The prospective plan is the phase-authorized evidence record; read-only scene memory is not edited.
predictions: Host fixed-state preflight: all four cells have identical outputs and native buffer updates. The new open endpoint reproduces parent gradients; the blocked endpoint reproduces the old common adapter detach. The two single-path context derivatives sum to the open derivative at fixed weights for each auxiliary loss; private derivatives and click derivatives remain equal.

Let A00/A10/A01/A11 be click AUC for blocked/residual-only/product-only/open. Product localization predicts A01-A00 > A10-A00 and A01>A00; complementarity is assessed separately as I=A11-A10-A01+A00. No sign is assumed for I in the primary localization claim.

If both paths are needed, A11 exceeds both single-path scores and a positive I repeats under a later authorized paired-seed suite. If one single path exceeds A11, retain that candidate provisionally and test the removed path as harmful before changing any other component.

Capacity stays at the inherited count; eval computation and throughput should be equivalent within measurement noise. Training costs can change because backward edges are removed. Record matched-pass quality and actual cost; do not call this an equal-compute result.
falsifiers: Any forward/state/initialization or private-derivative mismatch beyond declared FP32/BF16 tolerances invalidates attribution and must be repaired before interpreting scores; failures remain charged.
Product-only failing to beat fully blocked, or residual-only retaining at least as much benefit, contradicts the directional product-localization hypothesis at this implementation/seed.
A11 not exceeding both single paths or I<=0 fails to support positive path complementarity. Single-seed positive I alone is not repeated mechanism support.
If the fresh endpoints fail to reproduce the corresponding committed full-validation scores within justified host determinism tolerance, investigate execution drift before pooling results.

If later permitted paired repetitions show no consistent joint or selected-path advantage over click-only/blocked, withdraw the useful-auxiliary-supervision claim for this setting. No path outcome alone demonstrates gradient interference.
alternative_explanations: Deleting one context derivative also changes the aggregate gradient magnitude, direction and sparse Adagrad history; this is a path effect and cannot establish gradient interference or magnitude matching.
